Combine the reusable-result cache with quality processing in one extraction configuration.

```elixir title="Elixir"
input_value = %Xberg.ExtractInput{kind: "uri", uri: "https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf"}
result = Xberg.extract_async(input_value, "{\"enable_quality_processing\":true,\"use_cache\":true}")
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).quality_score)
```
